settings.question: Is melatonin safe to take every night?
settings.answer: For most healthy adults, low-dose melatonin is well tolerated for short-term use. Your doctor sets your dose and how long to take it, and checks in after your first month.

settings.question: Do I need a prescription first?
settings.answer: No. Take the sleep quiz and a licensed doctor reviews your answers before anything ships.

settings.question: How soon will I feel it?
settings.answer: Most people feel drowsy 30 to 60 minutes after a gummy, though everyone responds a little differently.

settings.question: Will I become dependent on it?
settings.answer: Melatonin isn’t generally considered habit-forming. Your doctor still decides how long you take it and checks in with you.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my subscription?
settings.answer: Yes. Change your formula, skip a month or cancel from your account. No fees.

settings.question: Where do you deliver?
settings.answer: Anywhere in Indonesia, free. Most major cities receive orders in 1 to 3 working days.

settings.title: Important safety information
settings.reg: BPOM reg. no. to be added

settings.text: Not suitable during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or for anyone under 18 unless a doctor advises it.
Melatonin can cause drowsiness. Don’t drive or operate machinery after taking it.
Tell your doctor if you take blood thinners, antidepressants, blood pressure medication or immunosuppressants, or have an autoimmune condition.
Stop and contact your doctor if you have an allergic reaction, a severe headache or any side effect that worries you.
Lelap doesn’t replace a medical diagnosis. If you’ve had trouble sleeping for more than three weeks, see a doctor in person.
Store in a cool, dry place out of reach of children.
